props.name: data
props.description: Regions as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of Polygons and MultiPolygons.

props.name: values
props.description: Value per region, keyed by what `featureKey` returns. Missing keys are drawn as “no data”.

props.name: featureKey
props.description: Key of a feature in `values`. Defaults to `feature.id`, then `properties.id`.

props.name: featureName
props.description: Name of a feature for labels. Defaults to `properties.name`, then the key.

props.name: projection
props.description: Equirectangular keeps areas honest near the equator; Mercator is what people expect of a world map.

props.name: steps
props.description: Colour steps between the lowest and highest value.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width fills the container.

props.name: format
props.description: Format values in the legend, tooltip and table.
